rules.birthDecision: Every incubating object declares its current anchor and destined authority before implementation expands.
rules.schemaOwner: Every persistent structured fact declares one schema owner at birth; FlatBuffers and Hana owners resolve through schema-authority.json, while a Domain Profile may name its versioned contract world.
rules.runtimePersistence: Runtime-anchored persistent bytes use the native journal. Scripts may own orchestration, folds, validation, and projections, but never durable byte identity.
rules.identityProtocol: Any object that mints a durable Root or identity preimage provides two independent implementation languages and shared golden vectors before admission.
rules.deadline: An incubating runtime object past its declared deadline is a gate failure.
rules.history: Registration and admission are additive. They never migrate, reinterpret, recalculate, or alias sealed evidence.
